product_metadata.title: Dog Bone Cookie Cutters Set of 8 Dog Bone Biscuit Cookie Cutter, Stainless Steel, Different Size for Homemade Baking Treats
features: Dog Bone Cookie Cutters Set: If you have a dog lover in the family, they will be sure to love this amazing set which includes 8 pieces of different sizes dog bone cookie cutters, perfect for dog biscuit recipes. Ditch your old shapers and say hello to your new, alternative ones! You can make a pet themed party with these, a must-have for every kitchen collection!

8 Various Sizes: 2.1’’, 2.6’’, 3’’, 3.4’’, 3.7’’, 3.8’’, 4.5’’, 5.2’’. Our cookie cutter set has the most amount of different, high quality shapes! Our mold set allows you to make 8 different sizes of bone cookies at the same time! It’s easy to get baking for your favorite canine with a variety of dog bone shapes and a dog biscuit recipe. Use for the dog in your life or pass it on as a gift for a dog lover.
Food Grade Safe Material: Our cookies cutters are made from food grade rust-proof stainless steel, light and strong, durable and safe, produced to high standards which will stand the test of time!

Care Instructions/Multipurpose: Hand wash, clean up with warm, soapy water, and dry immediately, not dishwasher safe. Use as a pancake mold, or for cutting cookie dough, fondant, soft fruits, bread, sandwiches, cheese, or craft clay.
Buy with confidence: We are committed to provide best products and services for you. Any questions please contact us, if you are not fully satisfied with your cookie cutters' purchase.
description: Perfect cookie cutters set to make DIY cookies and treats, also great for making fun, homemade treats
